question.text: A Nifty call option with strike 17,500 trades at Rs. 310. Above what level does the call buyer start making profit?

explanation.text: The Logic: Call BEP = Strike + Premium = 17,500 + 310 = Rs. 17,810 The call buyer starts making profit when Nifty goes ABOVE Rs. 17,810. - At 17,810: Payoff = 310 = Premium → breakeven - Above 17,810: Profit = (S - 17,500) - 310 > 0 The Trap: Profit starts above BEP, not above the strike price. Between strike and BEP, buyer recovers part of premium. Cross-Exam Context: This "above which level" format is a common exam question. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Call buyer profits when S > X + P = 17,810. The BEP is the profit threshold.
